# Deviload 2.7.9

## THE LAST PLANNED DEVILOAD UPDATE WITH DEVIL MUSIC INCLUDED

**Devil Music is planned to continue as a standalone project. Its new name and repository link will be announced when they are ready. Your current library remains available in this version.**

## Devil Cinema

**TEMPORARY: ONLINE VIDEOS USE THE OFFICIAL YOUTUBE PLAYER. OUR OWN PLAYER IS PLANNED FOR THE NEXT UPDATE.**

- Search YouTube by title, open videos and playlists, and watch from a thumbnail grid with an Up next queue.
- The home page restores cards from the last successful search after reopening. Related videos use the current title or channel; Cinema history is separate from music recommendations.
- Online playback uses YouTube's embedded player, including its quality, volume, captions and fullscreen controls. This replaces direct-stream extraction during playback and resolves the reproduced direct-MP4 403 failure for the tested Topuria–Oliveira video.
- Local media keeps Deviload's playback controls, seeking, speed, volume and theater view. The player header supports moving and maximizing the app window.
- Closing the player stops playback. Starting music pauses Cinema; next/previous and optional automatic advance follow the queue.
- Compact single-video metadata avoids large automatic-caption catalogs that previously caused the “Search results are too large” error.

YouTube's availability, embedding, account, advertising and regional rules still apply. Some videos cannot be embedded; **Open on YouTube** opens the original page. A future custom player will not remove source-side access restrictions.

## Devil Music and library improvements

- More flexible Spotify JSON/CSV imports, selection of all import entries, resumable matching and preservation of unresolved songs.
- Large libraries are no longer constrained by the old 2 MB profile cap. Favorites lists render visible rows instead of mounting the entire collection.
- Search suggestions, artist navigation, clearer queue handling and shuffle refinements.
- Updated Ambient styling, picture-disc artwork, a compact mini-player with queue controls, and improvements to lyrics display and synchronization.
- Larger artwork uses higher-resolution sources when available, while small list thumbnails remain lightweight.

Word-level lyric highlighting requires real word timestamps. Other tracks use timed lines or plain lyrics; missing timestamps are not invented.

The application identity, profile paths and signed updater endpoints remain unchanged. Normal installation over an existing Deviload installation preserves library and settings.
